advertising.title: Advertising & Affiliate Disclosure
advertising.body1: This website and my Pinterest profile contain advertising in the form of affiliate links. If you click such a link and then make a purchase, I receive a commission from the partner retailer. This does not cost you anything extra. These commissions help fund my content. They do not influence my recommendations: I only recommend what I genuinely find useful.
advertising.body2: On my Pinterest profile I share product picks from fashion, sport, home and gift ideas. Pins that contain affiliate links are marked as advertising. Affiliate partnerships run through networks such as Awin and Rakuten Advertising.
